lessons.title: Close-up: two players and a far hill

zoom.label: The seated woman's hands, near the middle of the picture

c1.text: Level one: the standing woman pours water. Now zoom to the woman seated with her back to us.

zoom.label: The seated woman's hands, near the middle of the picture

sources.title: Musée du Louvre, former website commentary on The Pastoral Concert, as reproduced by The Victorian Web
Walter Pater, 'The School of Giorgione', The Renaissance (1893 text), Project Gutenberg #2398

c1a.text: Yes. She holds a pipe, a simple flute, while the man beside her plays the lute.

c1b.text: No brush: it is an instrument.

correction.truth: It is a pipe, a simple flute.
correction.evidence: The crop; the Louvre; Walter Pater (1893).

correction.tempting: There is a shepherd in the picture.
correction.truth: She holds a pipe; the shepherd is far off on the right.
correction.evidence: The crop; the Louvre; Walter Pater (1893).

c1m.text: A pipe in her hands: music and water together.

zoom.label: The hands of the man in the red cap, in the middle of the group

c2.text: Level one: the men make music. Now zoom to the man in the red cap.

zoom.label: The hands of the man in the red cap, in the middle of the group

sources.title: Musée du Louvre, former website commentary on The Pastoral Concert, as reproduced by The Victorian Web

c2a.text: A harp stands upright; this lies across him.

correction.truth: He plays a lute, a round-backed string instrument held across the body.

c2b.text: No drum: look for strings and a neck.

correction.tempting: The body of it is round.
correction.truth: It is a lute, with a long neck and strings.

c2c.text: Yes. He plays a lute, its round body against his red sleeve, its neck reaching towards his companion.

c2m.text: A lute: the music at the heart of the scene.

zoom.label: The far right of the landscape, under the trees

c3.text: Level one: one figure is far away. Now zoom to the right, under the trees.

zoom.label: The far right of the landscape, under the trees

sources.title: Musée du Louvre, former website commentary on The Pastoral Concert, as reproduced by The Victorian Web

correction.tempting: A man walks with animals near a wood.
correction.truth: It is a shepherd with his flock.

c3b.text: Yes. A shepherd walks with his sheep under the trees: everyday country life behind the music.

c3c.text: No armour, no weapon: a shepherd.

correction.tempting: He carries something on his shoulder.
correction.truth: He is a shepherd with his flock.

c3m.text: A shepherd far off, the countryside going on.

extends.concept: From "the seated woman holds the pipe" (level) to the pipe itself, held to play

c1q.what_you_learn: The seated woman holds a pipe (a simple flute).

regionSources.title: Musée du Louvre, former website commentary on The Pastoral Concert, as reproduced by The Victorian Web
regionSources.quote: Two young men, one dressed in a red costume with bloused sleeves and playing a lute, the other blond with bare feet and simply dressed | one stands a little distance away and pours water into a fountain; the other, seated with her back to the viewer, plays the flute. In the background, under a grove of trees, a herdsman tends his sheep.
regionSources.supports: The lute player, the woman with the flute (pipe), the herdsman with his sheep in the background.

regionSources.title: Walter Pater, 'The School of Giorgione', The Renaissance (1893 text), Project Gutenberg #2398
regionSources.quote: as the woman pours it from a pitcher with her jewelled hand in the Fete Champetre, listening, perhaps, to the cool sound as it falls, blent with the music of the pipes
regionSources.supports: Music of pipes in the picture; one woman pours water.
